entries.title: Margin Dragon
entries.what: A painted dragon moves through a page of HTML text. The text re-flows round it on every frame, and where it breathes fire the page burns away.
entries.note: No page here changes layout on every frame because of something the canvas draws.

entries.title: Snowfall
entries.what: Snow settles on live HTML type. You can brush it off, type your own word or start a blizzard.
entries.note: The snow finds the letters by reading the pixels of the drawn text.

entries.title: Wishing Pond
entries.what: A web form at the bottom of a koi pond. You type a wish and throw a coin, and ripples and caustics bend the form.

entries.title: <hic-pageflip>
entries.what: A custom element for a book whose pages curl in 3D when you drag a corner. The text on a page stays selectable and its links work.
entries.note: The write-up explains the page-curl maths and why a 2D clip looks fake beside it.

entries.title: Curved Markup
entries.what: Selectable text on a curved screen in the style of an old VHS recording.

entries.title: Liquid DOM
entries.what: Liquid glass for the web in WebGPU. The glass changes shape and has live DOM inside it.

entries.title: Duck Hunt TODO
entries.what: A to-do form that is also a shooting game.

entries.title: Wobble Buttons
entries.what: Buttons that ripple when you press them.

entries.title: Compiz Web
entries.what: Page transitions drawn by shaders, after the Compiz window manager.

entries.title: HTML cloth
entries.what: A form on a hanging cloth inside a game. You can change the form while it hangs there.
entries.note: This site has no page that draws an element on a cloth mesh.

entries.title: PixiJS HTML Laser
entries.what: A landing page that shatters under a laser and heals over time, drawn with PixiJS.

entries.title: Quest Signal
entries.what: A playable Godot scene whose panels are DOM, drawn as textures in the world and still accessible.

entries.title: HTML in Canvas Demo
entries.what: Shader filters, a page curl, a CRT screen and an input that vanishes, all on live HTML.

entries.title: Elastic Bulge
entries.what: A bulge follows the pointer across laid-out HTML and casts a soft shadow.

entries.title: vgpu WebGPU Shader on Live HTML
entries.what: A DOM card under a WebGPU foil shader that warps on hover. The same pass runs in Node to make a share picture.

entries.title: Lemmings in HTML in Canvas
entries.what: The game Lemmings, played over HTML.

entries.title: Doom on a CRT
entries.what: A computer with a CRT screen, drawn from HTML.

entries.title: html-in-canvas.dev
entries.what: 21 demos in 2D, WebGL and WebGPU, each with annotated source you can fork. It takes demos from other people.

entries.title: Chrome's HTML-in-canvas demos
entries.what: 26 pages: 3D billboards, a book, a fluid prism and a deformable page, then tests of text, video, filters, iframes and scroll-driven animations.

entries.title: Awesome HTML-in-Canvas
entries.what: Chrome's list of demos by other people and of the frameworks that support the API. It accepts suggestions.

entries.title: CanvasUI
entries.what: 38 components built on the API, for React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and plain TypeScript. Each is an effect over a page or a block: cloth, heat haze, shatter, peel, glass.
entries.note: None of its components is a form control.

entries.title: VFX-JS Transitions
entries.what: Page transitions through WebGL shaders (glitch, datamosh, pixel sort, slit scan) for any router. It accepts gl-transitions shaders.
entries.note: It wraps the element in a canvas only while the transition plays. The rest of the time the page is plain DOM.

entries.title: three.js HTMLTexture
entries.what: A texture whose source is a live element.

entries.title: PixiJS HTMLSource
entries.what: A PixiJS texture source that takes a live element.
entries.note: Not tested on this site.

entries.title: PlayCanvas html-texture
entries.what: HTML as a texture in the PlayCanvas engine.
entries.note: Not tested on this site.

entries.title: Babylon.js HTML Texture
entries.what: HTML as a texture on a Babylon.js material.
entries.note: Not tested on this site.

entries.title: Elastic Volume Slider
entries.what: A volume slider whose track bends like a plucked string and springs back.
entries.note: An <input type="range"> bent by a 2D mesh of clipped draws.

entries.title: Wave Slider
entries.what: A row of thin bars dips like a wave round the handle as it moves, then flattens into ticks.
entries.note: An <input type="range"> with a <datalist>, each tick drawn as its own slice.

entries.title: Ruler Picker
entries.what: A ruler whose ticks swell under the pointer like a magnifier while the digits roll to the new value.
entries.note: A lens over a real list of ticks, and an <output> drawn in slices.

entries.title: Glass Slider
entries.what: A 3D render of a slider. A glass knob pushed along a dark track fills it with light that flares white at the end.
entries.note: A refraction shader on the thumb of an <input type="range">, with the flare on a float canvas.

entries.title: Liquid Storage
entries.what: A storage widget where each file type is a coloured liquid in one tube. Clearing the cache drains it.
entries.note: Several <meter> elements give the values and names, and a shader draws the liquid.

entries.title: Usage Limit Drain
entries.what: Each numeral of a usage count is a glass tube of liquid that drains as the count drops.
entries.note: The picture of an <output> used as a mask and filled to a level.

entries.title: Clock Calendar
entries.what: A day planner on a clock face. You drag the edges of a meeting round the dial to move it.
entries.note: Two time inputs, or the proposed <rangegroup>. A polar warp is not a matrix, so the pointer would be mapped by script.

entries.title: Aging Button
entries.what: A Save button that wears with use. Every click leaves marks until the paint is chipped.
entries.note: A <button> with a second canvas of wear composited over its picture.

entries.title: Realistic Button
entries.what: A button that sinks a little with each click and keeps a fingerprint where it was pressed.
entries.note: The same wear canvas, stamped at the point of each press.

entries.title: Hold to Delete
entries.what: Holding the delete button sets the page on fire from the button outwards.
entries.note: One canvas draws the page and a burn shader starts at the rectangle of the <button>.

entries.title: Swipe to Send
entries.what: A payment flow in one WebGL pass. Pushing the button up gathers light under it and ripples in the receipt.
entries.note: A vertical <input type="range"> and a receipt in a <dl>, under one shader pass.

entries.title: Liquid Arrow Button
entries.what: On hover the arrow end of a button pinches off into its own circle and melts back in.
entries.note: A blurred field of the button cut at a threshold, with the real <button> drawn sharp inside it.

entries.title: Liquid UI Components
entries.what: A tooltip, a colour select and an account menu that each pour out of their trigger and draw back in.
entries.note: An open popover inside a canvas cannot be drawn, so the menu stays an ordinary element until the pour ends.

entries.title: Reshaping Dock
entries.what: A dock whose outline bulges like a droplet round the icon you hover.
entries.note: A <nav> of links drawn inside a joined outline.

entries.title: Metaball Loader
entries.what: Six dots circle a ring, fuse into one crescent and split apart again.
entries.note: A <progress> element underneath, and the same joined outline.

entries.title: Gooey Sticky Menu
entries.what: A sticky menu whose shapes join and part like drops as you scroll, in GLSL.
entries.note: A <nav> that keeps its real labels inside the joined outline.

entries.title: Punch-Out Dropdown
entries.what: The trigger punches its own shape out of the open menu, so the list wraps round it.
entries.note: A customisable <select> whose picker canvas erases the rectangle of the trigger.

entries.title: Fold Toolbar
entries.what: Tool groups in a drawing tool unfold in place and fold back with the chosen tool as the icon.
entries.note: Groups of radio buttons in <details name>, unfolded in slices.

entries.title: Nav Experiment 2.0
entries.what: A round button in the corner of a phone fans its menu out along the curve of the screen.
entries.note: Each link is its own drawable element with its own rotation, so each keeps its hit box.

entries.title: Liquid Glass Tab Bar
entries.what: A tab bar whose selection is a lens. It slides between tabs and splits colour at its rim.
entries.note: A radio group under a refraction shader.

entries.title: Genie Minimise
entries.what: The macOS Genie effect on the web. A window bends into a funnel and pours into the dock.
entries.note: A <dialog> drawn in strips, each a source-rectangle draw at its own width.

entries.title: Crumpled Receipt
entries.what: A till receipt crumples into a paper ball at a click and can be thrown in a bin.
entries.note: A receipt in a <table> on a mesh with a crease map.

entries.title: CrumpledPaper Reveal
entries.what: A crumpled sheet smooths flat on hover with its creases still showing, then balls up again.
entries.note: The same mesh run backwards.

entries.title: Tear-off Ticket
entries.what: The stub of a boarding pass tears off along its perforation and swings on the pointer.
entries.note: Built here as the origami boarding pass.

entries.title: Slot Field
entries.what: One word holds still while lines of HTML open round it and pixel blocks fill the gap.
entries.note: Two source-rectangle draws of a paragraph, with the gap drawn by the canvas.

entries.title: Shader Transition
entries.what: A light to dark switch. A dome of light sweeps up the page and splits the text into colour fringes before it settles.
entries.note: A picture of the page from captureElementImage(), then a shader mixes old and new after color-scheme changes.

entries.title: Distortion Waves
entries.what: Confirming a payment pushes a glowing, fringed wave through the card.
entries.note: A displacement shader over a card with a <button>.

entries.title: glimm Spreadsheet Transition
entries.what: A band of blurred light sweeps up an empty spreadsheet and leaves it filled.
entries.note: A <table> whose rows are revealed by a shader as they arrive.

entries.title: Colony Card
entries.what: Colonies of cells grow from a tap on a card and recolour the words they cross.
entries.note: A growth simulation needs two buffers that swap each frame.

entries.title: An Infinite Carousel of Cloth Posters
entries.what: Posters are sheets of cloth that drape as you scroll, and the text on a sheet folds with it. WebGPU, with its own scrolling.
entries.note: With the API each poster could be a real <article> in a native scroller. A link on a draped poster could not be hit until the poster is flat.

entries.title: Some Ideas for Inline Hover Reveals
entries.what: Hovering a link reveals a picture inside the line of text, with a GLSL effect.
entries.note: Links in a paragraph, with the reveal drawn by the canvas that draws the paragraph.

entries.title: <rangegroup>: a range input with several thumbs
entries.what: A group of range inputs that share one track, with parts you can style. The prototype page has a video trim bar, a meeting slot and opening hours.
entries.note: On 19 November 2026 the group resolved that nested range groups are not conforming.

entries.title: Filterable select
entries.what: A <select> you can type into to filter its options. Two syntaxes are prototyped in Chromium behind the experimental web platform features flag.
entries.note: On 12 November 2026 the group settled the focus model: the text field keeps focus.

entries.title: Menu elements
entries.what: <menubar>, <menulist>, <menuitem>, <menuitemcheckbox>, <menuitemradio> and <submenu>, with the keyboard behaviour built in.

entries.title: <toolbar>
entries.what: An element for a group of controls with arrow-key movement between them.

entries.title: Declarative overscroll actions
entries.what: A drawer or an action that opens by scrolling past the edge of a scroller, declared in HTML and CSS.

entries.title: Switch attribute
entries.what: <input type="checkbox" switch>: a native switch that takes part in forms and can be styled.

entries.title: Richer text fields
entries.what: Highlights, ghost text, masking and range information inside <input> and <textarea>.

entries.title: Interest invokers
entries.what: interestfor: an element shows interest (hover, focus, long press) and a popover opens, with no script.

entries.title: HTML-in-Canvas in Chrome 157
entries.what: The announcement that the API is stable, with the case for it and a quickstart.

entries.title: HTML-in-Canvas documentation
entries.what: The reference for 2D, WebGL and WebGPU, and the technical concepts.

entries.title: The WICG explainer
entries.what: The proposal and the specification work, with the reasons behind the design.

entries.title: The Web Is Fun Again: First Experiments with HTML in Canvas
entries.what: A walk through the API with CodePen examples. It has a clear account of why sizing a canvas that has children is awkward.

entries.title: Exploring the HTML-in-Canvas Proposal
entries.what: An early look at the proposal from a site that has published WebGL and DOM techniques for years.

entries.title: Atelier UI: Mixing WebGL and the DOM in a React UI Library
entries.what: How a library keeps WebGL text and images in step with the DOM and the scroll position without the API.
entries.note: It shows the work the API removes.

entries.title: Memorables
entries.what: Hand-picked interface work. Each piece is credited and linked to where its maker first shared it.

entries.title: ui-feed
entries.what: 89 themed controls (a mercury tilt switch, a hand pump number input, a record player speed control), each with a prompt.

entries.title: Codrops
entries.what: Articles and demos on WebGL, shaders and motion, with source.

entries.title: Open UI
entries.what: Where new HTML controls are proposed and researched. The minutes of the weekly call are public.

entries.title: 60fps.design
entries.what: Curated gallery of app and web interaction clips.

entries.title: Detail
entries.what: Small interface animation and state-change studies.

entries.title: Hoverstat.es
entries.what: Archive of experimental web layouts, cursors and WebGL sites.

entries.title: Godly
entries.what: Catalogue of kinetic and shader-heavy web sites.

entries.title: GL Transitions
entries.what: Open-source library of GLSL fragment transitions between frames.

entries.title: Rive Community
entries.what: State-machine UI rigs and interactive motion files.

entries.title: Interface in Game
entries.what: Screenshots and clips of video-game HUDs, menus and transitions.

entries.title: rauno.me/craft
entries.what: Interactive UI prototypes with notes on timing and feel.

entries.title: emilkowal.ski
entries.what: Essays and components focused on interface motion and gestures.

entries.title: Add New Button
entries.what: A dark glass pill fills with an iridescent hover wave that drains back out on pointer leave.
entries.note: Keep a native button inside a drawable layer and drive a dispersive wave fill across its mask.

entries.title: SD Card Import
entries.what: An SD card control dissolves into particles on drop and reassembles as imported film frames.
entries.note: Read pixels from an offscreen copy of the dropped DOM card into a particle buffer that reforms over the destination cards.

entries.title: Pixel Menu
entries.what: Clicking a single dot bursts open a pixelated navigation menu and collapses back to the dot.
entries.note: Keep the menu links in live HTML inside a canvas that samples the menu texture on a snapping pixel grid.

entries.title: Glimm Feedback Effects
entries.what: A WebGL colour wash sweeps across generated cells to confirm completion.
entries.note: Draw the HTML table into WebGL and sweep a gradient refraction wave over the updated cell bounds.

entries.title: Spin to Reveal
entries.what: Spinning the front control flips open onto a holographic collectible card.
entries.note: Render front and back HTML card faces into WebGL and blend a spectral foil normal map across the spin angle.

entries.title: SOOC Viewer
entries.what: A horizontal filmstrip scrubber for stepping straight through camera frames.
entries.note: Place native radio or figure thumbnails along a drawable strip and bend the strip with cylindrical perspective in WebGL.

entries.title: Wallet Onboarding Screen
entries.what: An iridescent shader ribbon runs beside live headline text and sign-in controls.
entries.note: Keep the form inputs and headings as real DOM inside the canvas so ribbon highlights refract over the live typography.

entries.title: Grau Blur Tabs
entries.what: Active tab stays sharp while unselected navigation labels soften out of focus.
entries.note: Render a native tab list to WebGL and modulate directional Gaussian blur per element rect by distance from the active tab.

entries.title: Vanish Input
entries.what: Submitting a text field disintegrates the typed letters into drifting particles in place.
entries.note: Sample the live HTML input on submit into an offscreen 2D copy and scatter only the dark glyph texels across the field.

entries.title: Wheel Input
entries.what: A rotary tick wheel with detent physics for scrubbing numeric values.
entries.note: Back it with a real range input inside the canvas and paint perspective ticks and motion-blurred digits around the dial.

entries.title: Flashlight Tabs
entries.what: A pointer-tracked light beam reveals tab borders and active glows along a navigation strip.
entries.note: Upload the native tab strip into WebGL and shade rim illumination and bloom strictly around the pointer coordinates.

entries.title: Radial Menu
entries.what: A curved sector menu where angular pointer distance highlights the active wedge.
entries.note: Keep each command button live inside the canvas and warp sector highlights and scale toward the active angle.

entries.title: Smart corner morph animation
entries.what: Nested surface radii interpolate together cleanly as an expanded sheet transitions back to a pill.
entries.note: Morph the enclosing container with an exact SDF squircle in WebGL while keeping the inner sheet DOM readable.
